# 0.4.0
**Main window** - **Get started** no longer opens with an empty sidebar: the list and the notices were laid out off screen until a MicroVM was selected. - **Notices** are behind a bell in the toolbar, with a count. They used to float over the top of the shell. A new error opens the list by itself. - **Launch** with nothing selected shows the workspace's page, which says it's starting. A new workspace is selected when it's saved. - **Terminate…** names the MicroVM ("my-project · microvm-1a2b"), not only its workspace. A terminated MicroVM offers Launch Another, and stays under its workspace after the app restarts. - **Sidebar:** a click under the last row, or Escape, selects nothing. A selected MicroVM that leaves the list is deselected. - **View menu:** Refresh, Focus Sidebar and Show/Hide Sidebar. **Help menu:** User Guide (⌘?) and Website open the guide and the site in your browser. They replace the Help window: the guide on the website has the same pages, with pictures and two narrated walkthroughs. **Check for Updates…** is in the app menu: it was missing.
**Settings** - **The open tab** has its tile in colour; the others are grey. - **Check Permissions** no longer reports permissions as missing that the identity has: an administrator was told VPC connectors and EFS were missing. Its outcome shows beside the button and the results scroll into view. A "Permission needed" notice has Check Permissions…. - **Images:** a failed build shows the end of its build log, with the log in CloudWatch one click away. A build has a row from the moment it starts, with Show Progress…, and a notice when it ends. Python 3 shows as included while Mount /workspace at launch needs it. A name that is too long says by how much. - **Network:** New Connector says whether each subnet reaches the internet, and warns under one that doesn't. A connector being created no longer says "Internet: no". A connector a workspace can't use says why. - **The Settings window** stays on screen when you switch to another app, so a GitHub or Claude sign-in sheet is still there when you come back from the browser. - **Forms:** New Image, New Connector and New File System open without warnings, and their Name fields are named for VoiceOver. The starter image's time reads "about 5 minutes" everywhere.
**Workspaces** - **The first-run checklist's** third step is "Choose a default image", which is what ticks it. - **Editor:** a new workspace opens without warnings; Advanced has a Jump to menu for its 13 sections. - **New Role:** when the name is taken by a role tied to a deleted workspace, the sheet says why and offers the next name.
**Help** - Search marks the words it found in a topic and scrolls to the first.
